Miami SEO • Local Search • Google + AI Visibility

SEO Services in Miami for Local Businesses & Professional Practices

Miami businesses compete in one of the most crowded local markets in the country, and customers compare them across Google Search, Google Maps, reviews, service pages, and AI-assisted search before they ever call. Good SEO is not a ranking; it is being found by the people who are ready to buy, book, or schedule. FixWebsiteIssues.com, the technical SEO and marketing division of WevTEC, helps Miami-area businesses strengthen the technical, local, content, and conversion signals that decide who gets discovered, then turns that visibility into qualified inquiries. We work with Miami clients remotely from our Houston office, the same way we serve practices and companies nationwide, with a team you can reach by phone.

Technical SEO + Local SEO + Content + AI Search Readiness | Houston-Based, Serving Miami-Dade Remotely | Since 2013

Request a Free Miami SEO & AI Visibility Audit
Talk With FixWebsiteIssues
What decides who gets found in Miami
1
Can Google read the site?Crawlable, indexed, fast, mobile-ready
2
Does it match what customers search?Service, location, and question-level pages
3
Is the business consistent everywhere?Google Business Profile, citations, reviews
4
Is it trusted?Reviews, references, first-party expertise
5
Can an AI system understand it?Clear entities, direct answers, corroboration
Result: qualified calls, forms, and bookings, tracked to the source

What Can SEO Help Your Miami Business Improve?

Six outcomes, each measurable. Most Miami engagements start with the first three and add the rest as the foundation holds.

Google Search Visibility

Relevance for the services, products, locations, and questions your customers actually search, so the right pages appear for the right searches.

Google Maps & Local Search

Stronger local discovery through a complete Google Business Profile, consistent citations, reviews, and location pages that support the listing.

Technical SEO

Indexing, crawlability, speed, redirects, canonicals, broken links, and architecture repaired by engineers who fix websites every day.

Content Strategy

Service, location, and educational content built around real customer searches instead of what the business wants to say about itself.

Website Conversion

Calls, quote requests, appointments, forms, and purchase paths that work on a phone, so visibility becomes revenue.

AI Search Readiness

Clear business entities, direct answers, and consistent information so Google AI, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Copilot can understand and reference the business.

What Is SEO and What Does It Do for a Miami Business?

SEO (search engine optimization) is the work of making a business findable in search engines for the searches that lead to customers: making sure Google can crawl and index the site, that pages match what people search, that the business is trusted, that the site performs well, and that visitors can act once they arrive. For a Miami business it means appearing for “Coral Gables family dentist”, “HVAC repair Kendall”, or “med spa Brickell” when someone is deciding, and giving them a reason to choose you.

It is not adding keywords to a page. A modern SEO program touches nine things: crawling (can Google reach every page), indexing (are the right pages in the index and the wrong ones out), relevance (does each page clearly serve one search need), content (is it useful and specific to your business), local search (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, and location pages), authority (do other sources corroborate you), technical performance (speed, mobile, stability), conversion (does the visit become a call), and measurement (do we know what worked). A business that is strong on eight and missing one still loses the customer at that point.

Why Miami is different

Miami-Dade packs an unusual density of small businesses, medical and dental practices, aesthetic clinics, law firms, and real estate professionals into neighborhoods with distinct identities. Customers search by neighborhood, not just by city, and a large share search in Spanish as well as English. Rankings for “Miami” alone rarely tell the story; visibility in Brickell, Doral, or Kendall for the specific service is what fills the schedule.

What SEO is not

  • Repeating “near me” in page copy; Google infers proximity from the searcher
  • A caching plugin as the whole speed strategy
  • One “Services” page for six high-intent services
  • City pages that are the same text with the neighborhood swapped
  • An “AI keywords” block pasted at the bottom of a page

SEO vs. Digital Marketing: What Does Your Business Need?

SEO earns organic visibility. Local SEO earns Maps and neighborhood discovery. Google Ads buys immediate visibility. Digital marketing is the coordinated program that uses whichever of these fits the goal, plus content, conversion, and analytics. AI Search Optimization makes the business clear enough to be retrieved by AI-assisted discovery systems. Some Miami businesses need one discipline; growing ones usually need a coordinated plan so paid and organic do not compete for the same searches and every channel is measured against the same goal.

DisciplineWhat it doesTime to effectBest for
SEOOrganic visibility in Google and Bing for service, product, and question searchesMonths; compoundsDurable visibility for core services
Local SEOGoogle Maps and local-pack discovery through Google Business Profile, citations, reviews, and location pagesWeeks to monthsBusinesses customers visit or that serve a local area
Google AdsPaid placement for high-intent searches with precise geography and budget controlDays to weeksNew locations, new services, competitive procedures, immediate volume
Digital marketingStrategy across SEO, Local SEO, Ads, content, website conversion, and analyticsOngoingBusinesses that want one plan and one set of numbers
AI Search OptimizationEntity clarity, direct answers, and corroboration so AI systems can understand and reference the businessWeeks to months; observed, not rankedBusinesses whose customers ask assistants for recommendations

Our broader digital marketing services cover the coordinated program; this page is about the SEO discipline and how it applies in Miami.

Local SEO and Google Maps for Miami Businesses

Local SEO is the work of making a business visible in Google Maps and the local pack for searches with local intent, which in Miami means neighborhood-level searches like “dentist Coral Gables”, “plumber Doral”, or “med spa near Brickell”. It depends on the Google Business Profile, consistency of the business’s information across the web, the relevance of the website, reviews, and proximity to the searcher. Organic rankings and Maps rankings use overlapping but different signals; a business can be strong in one and absent in the other.

Proximity is a factor no agency controls, so we do not promise map-pack positions. What we do is remove every reason Google has to prefer a competitor: incomplete categories, inconsistent addresses, unanswered reviews, missing services, wrong hours, duplicate listings, and location pages that say nothing. For multi-location Miami businesses, each office gets its own listing, its own page, and consistent information tying the two together.

What Miami local SEO covers

  • Google Business Profile setup, verification, and management
  • Primary and secondary categories matched to the business
  • Services, products, and attributes on the profile
  • Name, address, and phone consistent everywhere
  • Local citations and directory cleanup
  • Review generation guidance and responses
  • Location pages that support each listing
  • Service-area relevance for businesses that travel to customers
  • Internal links between location, service, and industry pages
  • Duplicate and conflicting listing resolution
  • Call tracking implemented without breaking consistency
  • Maps visibility monitoring by query and neighborhood

Technical SEO for Miami Business Websites

Technical SEO is everything that lets Google crawl, render, index, and trust a website. When it fails, the best content and the strongest reviews simply do not appear, and the business usually has no idea why. This is where FixWebsiteIssues started: the company has repaired broken, hacked, slow, and de-indexed websites since 2013, and that repair background is what makes our SEO different from an agency that only writes content.

The technical problems we find most often on Miami business sites are ordinary and invisible from the front end: a noindex left on from a redesign, a redirect chain from an old domain, a staging site in the index, WooCommerce pages generating thousands of thin URLs, a caching plugin serving a stale layout to Googlebot, a theme update that broke schema, or a form that quietly stopped delivering. Each is fatal for search and none shows up in a rankings report.

Where a site needs deeper repair first, our SEO repair, WordPress error repair, and Miami hacked website repair teams handle it. For sites that need to stay fixed, see website maintenance in Miami.

What the technical audit covers

  • Crawlability and robots.txt
  • Indexability and accidental noindex
  • Redirects and redirect chains
  • Canonicals and duplicate pages
  • XML sitemap accuracy
  • Broken links and 404s
  • Page speed and Core Web Vitals
  • Mobile usability
  • JavaScript rendering of key content
  • Structured data validity
  • HTTPS and mixed content
  • Migration and domain-change damage
  • WordPress plugin and theme SEO conflicts
  • Internal linking and orphan pages
  • AI crawler access

SEO for Google and AI Search

Google Search, Google Maps, Google AI Overviews and Gemini, and conversational assistants such as ChatGPT and Copilot are four different discovery environments that share one foundation. A Miami business that is crawlable, clearly described, consistently listed, and corroborated by outside sources is positioned for all four; one that treats them as a single channel usually wins none of them well.

AI-assisted discovery adds one requirement to good SEO: the business has to be legible to a machine that is composing an answer. That means clear business entities (what you are, where you are, who runs it), explicit service relationships (which services, for whom, at which location), direct answers to common questions, structured page architecture, factual consistency across the web, internal links that show how pages relate, third-party corroboration such as reviews and directories, first-party expertise in your own words, and structured data where it reflects visible content. None of this guarantees a mention; it improves the likelihood of being understood, retrieved, and referenced. Our AI Search Optimization practice, including Generative Engine Optimization and Google AI Optimization, handles the deeper work; the AI Visibility Audit records where a business stands today.

Google Organic Search

Ranks web pages by relevance, quality, and authority. Rewards technical health, intent-matched pages, structure, and credible content. Measured in Search Console.

Google Maps

Ranks local entities, not pages, by relevance, distance, and prominence. Depends on the Google Business Profile, consistency, reviews, and the supporting website.

Google AI Overviews / Gemini

Compose an answer from Google’s index and link to sources. Favor factual clarity, accessible content, clear entities, and answer-oriented passages.

ChatGPT & Conversational Search

Answer natural-language questions by combining model knowledge with live retrieval. Depend on corroborated business information and content that answers directly.

SEO for Miami Businesses by Industry

Every industry has its own search vocabulary, buying journey, and competitive set. These are the Miami business types we work with and what shapes the strategy for each.

Small Businesses

Local service keywords, Maps presence, a fast site, service pages that match the phone calls, and lead forms that work. Usually the Basic foundation plus one or two service lines done well.

Miami small business marketing →

Healthcare / Medical Practices

Specialty, symptom, treatment, and physician searches with stricter trust expectations, practitioner listings on Maps, and advertising policy limits. Handled through our healthcare practice.

Miami healthcare marketing →

Dentists

“Dentist near me” competition at neighborhood level, emergency dental intent, and service pages for implants, cleanings, and pediatric care that each earn their own visibility.

Miami dental marketing →

Cosmetic Dentistry

Longer research journeys for veneers, whitening, and clear aligners, cost questions, before-and-after expectations, and consultation conversion rather than same-day booking.

Miami dental marketing →

Med Spas

Treatment-level searches for injectables, laser, and body contouring in one of the most competitive aesthetic markets in the U.S.; reviews and appointment conversion decide outcomes.

Miami med spa marketing →

Aesthetic Clinics

Provider credentials, treatment pages written responsibly, and clear pricing or consultation paths, with Maps presence in Brickell, Coral Gables, and Miami Beach.

Miami aesthetic marketing →

Plastic Surgeons

Procedure-specific journeys, national and local intent, surgeon profiles, and reputation, in a market where patients travel for care.

Miami plastic surgery marketing →

Law Firms

Practice-area pages, attorney profiles, high-cost competitive terms, and the trust signals clients look for before contacting a firm.

Law firm SEO →

Real Estate

Neighborhood and property-type intent, agent and team pages, listing pages that expire, and IDX integrations that create technical debt.

HVAC

Emergency and seasonal demand, service-area coverage across Miami-Dade, repair versus install intent, and phone-first conversion.

Plumbing

Emergency searches, “open now” intent, service-area pages, and reviews that decide who gets the call.

Roofing

Storm-driven demand spikes, insurance-claim questions, and credibility signals for a high-ticket, high-trust purchase.

Construction

Commercial credibility, project galleries, RFQ forms, licensing and insurance clarity, and bid-request conversion.

Construction SEO →

Remodeling

Kitchen, bath, and addition searches with long research phases, portfolio-heavy pages that need speed work, and estimate conversion.

Cleaning Companies

Residential and commercial intent, instant-quote forms, service-area pages, and Maps presence across neighborhoods.

Automotive Businesses

Repair, body, tire, and detailing searches, booking integrations, inventory feeds, and hours accuracy.

Automotive SEO →

Restaurants

Cuisine and neighborhood intent, menu visibility, reservations and ordering integrations, and reviews on Maps.

Retail and hospitality SEO →

Ecommerce

Product and category architecture, faceted-navigation bloat, product schema, speed, and checkout conversion on WooCommerce and Shopify.

Professional Services

Accountants, consultants, financial and insurance advisors: expertise-driven content, service pages, and trust signals over volume.

SEO for Small Businesses in Miami

Small business SEO in Miami means winning the local service searches that turn into phone calls: a Google Business Profile that is complete and consistent, a fast website with a page for each service you actually sell, forms and click-to-call that work on a phone, reviews that keep coming, and content that covers the neighborhoods you serve without duplicating itself. It is smaller in scope than an enterprise program and more sensitive to the basics being wrong.

Where it helps, Google Ads runs alongside SEO with the same conversion tracking, so the owner sees cost per lead by channel rather than two reports that disagree. And because a small business rarely has anyone watching the site, maintenance is part of the plan: updates, backups, security, and a monthly check that the forms still deliver. Our Miami small business marketing page covers the full program by trade.

What a small business engagement usually includes

  • Local service keyword and neighborhood research
  • Google Business Profile optimization and reviews
  • Site speed and mobile fixes
  • One page per service, written to match the calls you want
  • Service-area content that is not duplicated
  • Lead forms and call tracking that report to one dashboard
  • Google Ads integration where it pays
  • Monthly website maintenance
  • AI-search readiness: clear entity and service information

Healthcare SEO for Miami Doctors and Medical Practices

Healthcare SEO in Miami follows the patient journey from symptom to specialist to nearby provider, across a market with dense specialty competition and multilingual patients. It requires specialty, condition, treatment, and procedure pages in patient language, physician and location pages that Google can connect, careful Google Maps management including practitioner listings, medically responsible content, and Google Ads run within healthcare policy. Trust expectations are higher for medical sites, and AI-assisted search increasingly answers “what kind of doctor treats” questions by retrieving practice pages that state things plainly.

This is a summary. The full approach, specialty by specialty, is on our Miami healthcare marketing page, backed by the national healthcare SEO and medical marketing pillar.

Related

Miami healthcare resources

  • Healthcare SEO and medical marketing in Miami
  • Urgent care SEO in Miami
  • Healthcare SEO Miami guide (article)
  • National healthcare SEO pillar

Dental SEO for Miami Practices

Dental SEO in Miami is decided at neighborhood level: “dentist near me” and “dentist Coral Gables” searches go to the practice with the most complete Google Business Profile, the strongest recent reviews, and a website whose service pages match what the patient needs. Emergency dental, implants, veneers, clear aligners, and pediatric care each have their own search demand and deserve their own page; one “Services” page competes for all of them and wins none. Cosmetic services carry a longer research phase and convert on consultations rather than same-day bookings, so the pages must answer cost, candidacy, and what-to-expect questions before asking for the call.

The dental program in full, including Maps, Ads, and conversion, is on our Miami dental marketing page. Our dental SEO Miami article covers common ranking problems.

Dental searches that need their own page

  • Emergency dentist and same-day appointments
  • Dental implants and All-on-4
  • Veneers and cosmetic dentistry
  • Invisalign and clear aligners
  • Teeth whitening
  • Pediatric and family dentistry
  • Root canals, crowns, and extractions
  • Dentists who accept specific insurance or offer financing

SEO for Miami Med Spas and Aesthetic Clinics

Med spa SEO in Miami is treatment-level: customers search for Botox, fillers, laser hair removal, body contouring, microneedling, or skin treatments by name and by neighborhood, compare reviews and before-and-after credibility, and book online or call. Winning requires a well-written page per treatment, provider credentials that are visible, Google Maps presence in the neighborhoods that matter, reviews handled well, and an appointment path that works on a phone.

Miami is among the most competitive aesthetic markets in the country, so Google Ads often runs alongside SEO for the highest-value treatments, and AI-assisted discovery is starting to answer “where should I get” questions by retrieving clinic pages with clear provider and treatment information. Treatment pages are written for search and marketing context only; we make no medical claims and defer to the clinic’s providers on clinical content. The full program is on our Miami med spa and aesthetic marketing page, supported by our national med spa SEO service.

Aesthetic searches that drive bookings

  • Botox and neuromodulators
  • Dermal fillers and lip filler
  • Laser hair removal and laser skin treatments
  • Body contouring
  • Microneedling and chemical peels
  • Medical-grade facials and skin care
  • Membership and package pricing questions
  • Provider and clinic reviews by neighborhood

SEO Services Across Miami-Dade

Miami customers search by neighborhood. These are the areas where local intent is strongest for the business types we serve; each is served remotely from our Houston office, and none is a FixWebsiteIssues location.

Miami (Citywide)

Citywide searches are the most competitive and the least specific. We use them for services that genuinely draw from the whole county, and neighborhood pages for the rest, so a business is not spending its authority on a term it cannot win alone.

Brickell

Professional services, financial and legal firms, luxury retail, concierge healthcare, and aesthetic clinics serving a dense residential and office population. Competition is heavy on Maps; reviews and precise location signals matter.

Coral Gables

Healthcare, dentistry, legal, real estate, and established professional practices with long-standing reputations. Search here rewards credentials, physician and attorney profiles, and consistency across directories.

Doral

Small businesses, logistics and trade companies, healthcare, and professional services with a large bilingual customer base. Spanish-language search is often a genuine opportunity, and service-area coverage matters for businesses that travel.

Kendall

Healthcare, dentistry, home services, and consumer businesses serving large residential neighborhoods. “Near me” intent is high, Maps presence decides most first calls, and service pages need to match a family’s everyday needs.

Miami Beach

Hospitality, restaurants, aesthetics, dermatology, and tourism-facing businesses with seasonal demand and visitors searching in multiple languages. Reviews and hours accuracy carry unusual weight.

Aventura

Retail, medical and dental practices, aesthetics, and professional services near Aventura Mall with an affluent, review-conscious customer base and competition from nearby Broward providers.

Coconut Grove

Boutique retail, restaurants, wellness, and professional practices in a walkable neighborhood where local identity is strong and customers search the neighborhood name directly.

South Miami

Medical and dental practices near the hospital corridor, family services, and local retail. Proximity to Coral Gables and Kendall means overlapping search areas that need clear location signals.

Hialeah

Home services, automotive, industrial suppliers, healthcare, and small businesses serving a predominantly Spanish-speaking community. Bilingual content and Spanish-language reviews are often decisive.

English and Spanish Search Opportunities in Miami

Some Miami businesses gain real visibility from Spanish-language pages, when their customers genuinely search in Spanish. Done well, Spanish SEO is professionally written content for a distinct search intent, not machine translation of the English site. Terms, phrasing, and even service names differ, and a translated page that reads like a translation earns neither trust nor rankings.

When it is justified, we plan Spanish pages with their own research, translated navigation where useful, local terminology, correct hreflang between en-US and es-US versions, and consistent business information in both languages. We recommend it when the data supports it, and we do not mass-produce translated pages. Spanish pages are a separate project and are not created as part of a standard SEO engagement.

When Spanish pages usually pay off

  • Home services, automotive, and trades in Hialeah, Doral, and west Miami-Dade
  • Healthcare and dental practices with Spanish-speaking front desks
  • Legal and immigration services
  • Real estate serving Latin American buyers
  • Businesses whose reviews are already partly in Spanish

When they usually do not

  • The business cannot serve customers in Spanish
  • The English site has unresolved technical or content problems
  • The only goal is more pages

SEO Works Better When the Website Is Technically Healthy

Broken pages, slow load times, malware, outdated plugins, bad redirects, indexing problems, failed forms, and downtime all undo SEO quietly. A ranking earned over months can disappear in a week when a plugin update takes the site down or a security warning appears in the browser. That is why our Miami SEO clients are offered maintenance as part of the plan rather than as an afterthought.

Maintenance is a separate service with its own page: website maintenance services in Miami. This SEO page assumes the site is stable; if it is not, that comes first.

What undermines SEO most often

  • Hack or malware injection adding spam pages
  • PHP or plugin update breaking layout or checkout
  • Contact form silently failing
  • Expired SSL or mixed-content warnings
  • Host retiring a PHP version
  • Redirect chains after a redesign
  • Staging site indexed

Our Miami SEO Process

Nine stages in the order that prevents wasted effort. Content is not written until Google can read the site, and Maps work is not started until the business information is consistent. Timelines are set in the audit for each business, not promised here.

Start With a Free Audit
  1. SEO and competitive auditTechnical health, index coverage, current visibility, Maps standing, and who currently wins each search.
  2. Search intent researchHow Miami customers phrase the searches that lead to calls, by service and neighborhood, in English and, where relevant, Spanish.
  3. Technical SEO repairsCrawl, index, speed, redirect, canonical, and rendering fixes, applied by our engineers.
  4. Website architecture improvementOne page per service, one per location, clear hubs, and the internal links that connect them.
  5. Content optimization and developmentService, location, and question-level content written for the business, reviewed before publishing.
  6. Local SEO and Google MapsBusiness Profile, citations, reviews, and location pages brought into agreement.
  7. AI search readinessEntity clarity, direct answers, corroboration, and crawler access for AI systems.
  8. Conversion optimizationCalls, forms, booking, and mobile paths tested with real submissions.
  9. Measurement and ongoing improvementMonthly reporting on qualified inquiries and the visibility behind them; effort moved to what is working.

How We Measure SEO Performance

Qualified business opportunities matter more than traffic. A Miami business can double its visitors on searches that never convert; it can add a handful of neighborhood service rankings and book out. Reporting is built around the second result and written for an owner, not an SEO.

  • Non-brand organic clicks and impressions by service and neighborhood
  • Rankings for the searches that matter, not a vanity list
  • Maps visibility by query and area; Google Business Profile calls, visits, and directions
  • Tracked phone calls, forms, appointment requests, and bookings by source
  • Ecommerce actions and revenue where relevant
  • Conversion rates by page
  • Technical health: index coverage, Core Web Vitals, errors
  • Google Ads cost per qualified lead where Ads run
  • AI visibility observations from a fixed prompt set, recorded as observations

Observations from Miami and other markets we serve

  • Ranking is useless if the form does not work; we test every form with a real submission before reporting a win.
  • Traffic from the wrong searches costs money in support time and hides the real numbers.
  • One generic service page cannot cover six high-intent services; it ranks for none well.
  • Duplicated neighborhood pages weaken the whole site, not just the copies.
  • Local and organic SEO overlap but need different signals; strong in one does not mean strong in both.
  • A caching plugin alone does not solve Core Web Vitals; the theme, images, and scripts usually do.
  • Google Maps visibility is not improved by repeating “near me” in copy.
  • AI visibility cannot be created by adding an “AI keywords” block; it comes from clarity and corroboration.
  • Internal linking should tell Google how services, industries, and neighborhoods relate.

More Visibility Is Valuable Only When Visitors Take Action

The visit that arrives from a Miami search is usually on a phone, often between other tasks, and decides in seconds whether to call, request a quote, book, or leave. Conversion work makes the next step obvious, fast, and credible. We check the same things on every site: a clear call to action above the fold, a tappable phone number, a quote or appointment form that is short and actually delivers, booking that does not require an account, services and locations stated plainly, trust signals such as reviews, licenses, and credentials, a page that loads quickly on a mobile connection, and a design that looks like a business worth calling.

Conversion checklist

  • Primary CTA visible without scrolling
  • Click-to-call in the mobile header
  • Quote and appointment forms under five fields

What does an SEO company in Miami do?

It makes a business findable for the searches that lead to customers: fixing the website so Google can read it, building pages that match what people search, managing the Google Business Profile and local signals, earning trust through reviews and corroboration, and measuring calls and forms rather than traffic. A good one also prepares the business for AI-assisted discovery.

How much does SEO cost in Miami?

Most small and mid-sized Miami businesses invest between a few hundred and a few thousand dollars per month, depending on competition, number of services and locations, and whether Google Ads or maintenance is included. We quote after a free audit so the scope reflects the actual work; there is no standard package price on this page because the range is too wide to be honest about.

How long does SEO take?

Technical fixes take effect within weeks of a re-crawl. New or rewritten service pages typically need several months to earn stable visibility, longer in competitive Miami categories such as aesthetics, dental, and legal. Maps improvements often show sooner. Timelines are estimated in the audit, not guaranteed.

Does Local SEO help Google Maps rankings?

Yes. Maps ranks on relevance, distance, and prominence; Local SEO improves relevance and prominence through the Google Business Profile, consistent citations, reviews, and supporting location pages. Distance cannot be changed, which is why no agency can guarantee a map-pack position.

Can SEO help a small business in Miami?

Yes, and often more than it helps a large one, because the basics are frequently missing: an incomplete Business Profile, no service pages, a slow site, or a form that fails. Fixing those, adding neighborhood relevance, and tracking calls produces results a small business can feel.

Do medical practices need specialized SEO?

Yes. Healthcare sites face higher trust expectations, a longer patient journey from symptom to specialist, practitioner and practice listings on Maps, and advertising policy limits. We handle it through a dedicated healthcare practice with a Miami page.

Do dentists need Local SEO?

Yes. Most dental searches carry local intent and are decided in Google Maps by profile completeness, reviews, and proximity, with the website supporting the listing through service pages for implants, emergency care, cosmetic dentistry, and aligners.

How can a med spa improve Google visibility?

With a well-written page per treatment, visible provider credentials, a complete Google Business Profile in the neighborhoods it serves, reviews handled well, an appointment path that works on a phone, and, in Miami’s competitive aesthetic market, Google Ads for the highest-value treatments alongside SEO.

Should Miami businesses create neighborhood pages?

Only when each page can say something genuinely different about serving that neighborhood. Ten pages that are the same text with the neighborhood swapped weaken the whole site. A few pages with real local content, plus a strong Business Profile, outperform a doorway-page approach.

Does website speed affect SEO?

Yes. Page speed and Core Web Vitals are part of Google’s page-experience signals, and a slow mobile page loses visitors before they act. A caching plugin alone rarely solves it; images, scripts, theme code, and hosting usually do.

Can you fix an existing website's SEO?

Yes. Most of our clients come with sites built by someone else. We audit, repair the technical foundation, restructure pages, and improve content without requiring a redesign unless one is warranted.

Can SEO and Google Ads work together?

Yes, and they should share one set of conversion numbers. Ads produce immediate visibility for high-intent searches while SEO builds, and the search-term data from Ads informs which pages to build. We run both against the same qualified-lead goal.

What is AI Search Optimization?

The work of making a business clear, consistent, crawlable, and corroborated enough that AI-assisted search systems can understand what it does, where it is, and which questions it answers, so it is more likely to be retrieved and referenced. It builds on SEO; it does not replace it.

Can a business improve its visibility in ChatGPT or Gemini?

It can improve the likelihood. These systems retrieve live pages and rely on consistent business information across the web. Clear entity and service information, direct answers, corroboration, and crawler access help; no one can guarantee a mention.

What is the difference between SEO and GEO?

SEO earns a ranked link in search results. GEO, Generative Engine Optimization, works on being the source a generative engine retrieves and cites when composing an answer. GEO depends on SEO and adds passage clarity, entity consistency, and corroboration.

Do Spanish pages help Miami businesses?

They can, when customers genuinely search in Spanish and the business can serve them in Spanish. Professionally written Spanish content with correct hreflang and consistent business information is a separate project from English SEO and is recommended only when the data supports it.

Can you manage WordPress SEO?

Yes. WordPress and WooCommerce are the platforms we work with most, including plugin and theme SEO conflicts, Yoast or Rank Math configuration, speed, and security. We also work on Shopify and custom PHP sites.

How do you measure SEO success?

By qualified inquiries and the visibility behind them: tracked calls, forms, bookings, Business Profile actions, non-brand organic clicks for the searches that matter, conversion rates by page, technical health, and recorded AI visibility observations. Traffic totals alone are not a success measure.
